summary: Iteration 78 - Multi-Language Support Testing Complete. All 11 features tested and passed. Language switcher works correctly in sidebar (compact mode with flag icon) and in public guest page headers. All 7 languages (English, Turkish, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, French, German) translate sidebar labels correctly. Arabic triggers RTL direction. Language preference persists in localStorage (key: mhb_lang).

language_switcher_sidebar.description: Language switcher visible in sidebar bottom area (compact mode with flag icon)
tests: Compact mode shows flag icon only (no text)

language_dropdown_7_languages.description: Clicking language switcher shows dropdown with all 7 languages with flags
tests: Dropdown opens on click with data-testid='language-dropdown'
Turkish (🇹🇷 Türkçe) option present with data-testid='lang-option-tr'
Spanish (🇪🇸 Español) option present with data-testid='lang-option-es'
Russian (🇷🇺 Русский) option present with data-testid='lang-option-ru'
Arabic (🇸🇦 العربية) option present with data-testid='lang-option-ar'
French (🇫🇷 Français) option present with data-testid='lang-option-fr'
German (🇩🇪 Deutsch) option present with data-testid='lang-option-de'

turkish_translation.description: Selecting Turkish changes all sidebar labels to Turkish
tests: Section headers translated (YORUM MERKEZİ, REZERVASYON MOTORU, MİSAFİR DENEYİMİ)

spanish_translation.description: Selecting Spanish changes sidebar to Spanish
tests: Section headers translated (CENTRO DE RESEÑAS, MOTOR DE RESERVAS, EXPERIENCIA DEL HUÉSPED)

russian_translation.description: Selecting Russian changes sidebar to Russian
tests: Section headers translated (ЦЕНТР ОТЗЫВОВ, СИСТЕМА БРОНИРОВАНИЯ, ОПЫТ ГОСТЯ)

language_persistence.description: Language preference persists on page reload (localStorage)

registration_page_language_switcher.description: Public guest registration page has language switcher in header
tests: Language switcher found in registration header

registration_page_translations.description: Registration page translates step labels, form labels, buttons when language changes

feedback_page_language_switcher.description: Public feedback page has language switcher and translates buttons/labels
tests: Language switcher in header (code verified in GuestFeedbackPage.js line 97)
Feedback form uses t() function for all labels
Submitted state shows translated 'Thank You!' and 'We're glad you're enjoying your stay!'

arabic_rtl_direction.description: Arabic selection changes text direction to RTL
tests: document.documentElement.dir set to 'rtl' when Arabic selected
Sidebar moves to right side of screen
Arabic labels displayed correctly (لوحة التحكم, التقييمات, التحليلات, etc.)

english_restoration.description: Switching back to English restores all English labels
tests: All sidebar labels back to English

critical_code_review_comments: i18n implementation is well-structured with LanguageProvider context and useTranslation hook
All 7 translation files (en.json, tr.json, es.json, ru.json, ar.json, fr.json, de.json) are complete with 170+ keys each
LanguageSwitcher component properly handles compact mode for sidebar and full mode for headers
RTL direction correctly set via document.documentElement.dir for Arabic
localStorage persistence implemented correctly with key 'mhb_lang'
All sidebar navigation items use t() function for translation
Guest registration and feedback pages properly integrate language switcher in headers
data-testid attributes properly implemented for all language-related elements
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 78 tested multi-language support. The app now supports 7 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, French, German. Language switcher is at bottom of sidebar (compact mode with flag icon) for staff dashboard and in header for public guest pages. localStorage key 'mhb_lang' stores preference. Arabic triggers RTL layout. All translation files are in /app/frontend/src/i18n/ directory. LanguageProvider wraps the app at root level (AppWithLanguage component in App.js).

mocked_apis.note: All features are fully functional - no mocked APIs
